problem.description: A video render in the running source app failed while Remotion navigated its headless browser to the temporary local render page.
symptoms: The latest video_jobs row failed at 2026-10-14T09:10:53Z; its prior video_remotion.mp4 remains on disk.
The app reported a failed navigation to http://localhost:3000/index.html.
error_messages: The video could not be rendered: Remotion render failed: Error: Visited "http://localhost:3000/index.html" but got no response.

hypotheses.description: Node, Chrome Headless Shell or Remotion install is missing or broken
A transient headless browser navigation or local server failure occurred during the full render
A competing process occupied port 3000 at failure time
Resource pressure from the full episode or the large public asset tree caused a tab to fail

tests_run.output: Latest project job failed with the reported message at 09:10:53Z; previous video file remains present.
Exit 0; bundling, Chrome launch and localhost:3000 composition navigation succeeded.
Exit 0; three frames rendered to a temporary MP4.
Node v24.20.0 available; no current listener on port 3000; about 18 GB physical memory free; renderer/public/remotion-render about 810 MB.

tests_run.command: Phase 46 focused regression and read-only full episode render
tests_run.output: 47 focused tests passed. A full 240.917333-second 1280x720 H.264/AAC episode rendered in 194.886 seconds using read-only source data; details in docs/operations/phase46-render-reliability.md.

findings: Remotion's installed gotoPageOrThrow emits this exact message when page.goto returns a null navigation response; the message alone does not identify why.
The temporary localhost:3000 endpoint is started by Remotion for a render and is not a user-facing app server.
Current lightweight checks pass, so the failure is not continuously reproducible. No shipping fix is justified without a confirmed cause.

resolution.root_cause: Unconfirmed: Remotion returned a null response from page.goto on its temporary localhost page.
resolution.implementation: One fresh process for this exact error, at most two attempts within the shared 600-second budget; persistent verbose logs; prior video preserved.
resolution.verification: 47 focused tests passed. A full 240.917333-second 1280x720 H.264/AAC episode rendered in 194.886 seconds using read-only source data; details in docs/operations/phase46-render-reliability.md.
resolution.limitation: Original browser failure was not reproduced in the real run. Recovery was verified by fault injection; no owner visual gate is accepted.
